temporaryMaterialDeleted.reason: Focused tests own and remove their synthetic temporary directories. No screenshot, recording, raw log, private key file, signature file, or live review artifact was retained.

explicitRetentionExceptions: Implementation and schemas are review candidates on a TEST branch, not disposable session evidence.
